title: Formal Methods Meet LLMs: Auditing, Monitoring, and Intervention for Compliance of Advanced AI Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical application of Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) to monitor and audit the behavior of LLMs in task-oriented environments (logistics, cooking, and science experiments). While it addresses AI governance and compliance with 'norms' and 'rules', it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical frameworks.
